source_original_author_data: Bartling et al., Free to Fail, author ZIP Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23420381; no source respondent rows processed in this step
method: Standard Frechet bounds plus two-sided Hoeffding (1963) for six marginals and Bonferroni simultaneous correction; not original theory
original_design_source: Bartling et al. (2023), IZA Discussion Paper 16151, https://docs.iza.org/dp16151.pdf, PDF pp.9-10 and 19
original_design_directly_checked: Study 1: two-by-two between-subjects soft/hard and internal/external randomized treatment arms

Study 1: Dynata quota recruitment by gender, age, education, income and region; attention filter before equal-probability random assignment; not a probability sample guaranteed representative of all US adults
Study 2: same recruitment procedures, participants excluded if they had joined Study 1; hard and soft internal conditions plus mandatory welfare choice
coverage_interpretation: Conditional on specified independent Bernoulli sampling and the randomized-arm causal assumptions, all three entire true Frechet identified sets lie inside their respective outer envelopes with joint probability at least 0.95. Not an optimal or sharp inference procedure.
identification_assumptions: Independent Bernoulli sampled decisions within each intervention cell, a common target response distribution within a fixed error-attribution regime
As-if randomized soft/hard assignment, potential-outcome consistency, positivity and no interference
No unresolved selection, attrition or measurement error capable of breaking exchangeability
No transfer from US online study participants to all people or artificial intelligence
original_1_english: For each of three comparable soft/hard conditions, compute pointwise Frechet bounds on an unobserved soft-only potential-response type. Protect all six sample means with a union bound: epsilon_i=sqrt(log(12/0.05)/(2*n_i)). Simultaneous marginal envelopes imply conservative 95-percent outer confidence envelopes for the entire identified sets under the stated stochastic model, not for benevolent intent. The 2023 original explicitly says the first study used a Dynata quota-recruited sample and randomized participants after an attention filter; this does not certify probability sampling of US adults. The study design provides intervention randomization, not universal population representativeness. Do not pool internal/external regimes for latent-type claims without a common mixture target. The point estimate, sampling model, behavioral motive, and external validity are separate claims.
original_2_korean: 내부/외부 오류귀속 조건을 구분하여 동일 개체의 미관측 soft-only 잠재 선택유형에 Fréchet 부분식별 경계를 적용했다. 여섯 주변비율 각각에 Hoeffding 오차폭 epsilon_i=sqrt(log(12/0.05)/(2*n_i))를 두고 합집합 경계(Bonferroni)로 동시 95% 보수적 외피를 계산했다. 이는 명시된 확률표본 모형의 가정하에서 부분식별집합 전체를 덮는 통계적 구간이지 선한 내재동기에 대한 확신이 아니다. 2023 원저자 원문에서 Study1은 Dynata의 인구특성 할당표본으로 모집한 뒤 주의력 검사를 통과한 참가자를 무작위 배정했음을 확인했다. 따라서 배정 무작위성과 미국 전체 인구의 확률표본 대표성은 별개다. 내부/외부 처치조건의 단순 합산을 개인별 유형 증명으로 승격하면 안 된다. 독립 추출·비응답·측정오류에 대한 외적 타당성은 별도 보류한다.
